help.title: Help Center
help.chatSendA: Type in the input box at the bottom and press Enter to send. Shift+Enter for a new line.
help.chatModelA: Click the model selector above the input box to switch. You can manage model providers in Settings.
help.chatContextA: Each conversation maintains an independent context. Long conversations are automatically compressed to save tokens.
help.chatSummary: Send messages and chat with AI models
help.agentSwitchQ: How to switch to Agent mode?
help.agentSwitchA: Switch to Agent mode using the mode selector at the top of the conversation.
help.agentToolQ: What tools can the Agent use?
help.agentToolA: The Agent can read and write files, execute Bash commands, search the web, invoke MCP tools, and more. You can approve or deny permission requests.
help.agentSummary: Let AI autonomously plan and execute tasks
help.knowledgeUploadA: Drag and drop or select files to upload on the Knowledge Base page. Supports PDF, Markdown, plain text, and other formats.
help.shortcutsGlobalQ: What are the common keyboard shortcuts?
help.shortcutsGlobalA: Ctrl+N: New conversation · Ctrl+Shift+I: Open Settings · Ctrl+Shift+G: Open Gateway · ?: Open Help panel
help.providersAddQ: How to add a model provider?
help.providersAddA: Go to Settings → Model Providers page, click the Add button, select the provider type, and fill in the configuration.
help.workflowCreateA: Go to the Workflow page, drag nodes from the sidebar onto the canvas, and connect them to build your workflow.
help.workflowRunA: Click the Run button in the top-right corner of the workflow editor. You can also debug step by step.
help.skillsInstallA: Go to the Skills page to browse and install skills from the marketplace, or create your own.
help.skillsUseA: Installed skills appear as slash commands in the chat input. Type / to see available skills.
help.gatewaySetupQ: How to set up the gateway?
help.gatewaySetupA: Go to the Gateway page, configure your API keys and routing rules. The gateway allows unified access to multiple providers.
help.gatewayMonitorA: The Gateway page shows real-time metrics including request counts, latency, and token usage.
help.onboardingReplayDesc: Restart the interactive tutorial to re-learn the interface
